# Progress
Atlas Progress v1 - a horizontal bar showing how far a task has got, with an optional label, value text and helper text. 1 variant property: State determinate | indeterminate (2 total), plus Label, Value and Helper switches and their text. Determinate fills value / max of the track; indeterminate slides a segment along it when the duration is unknown. The bar is the internal .Progress / Bar set: track background-muted, fill primary, height 4 (spacing/1), radius/full. value and max are code props, not variants. Label row, bar and helper stack with spacing/2. A progress bar has no fixed width: it fills its container.

When to use: a task with a known percentage or step count (upload, export, form steps), or a running task of unknown length (indeterminate).
When not to use: for a wait with no layout at all (use Spinner), for content that is still loading into a known layout (use Skeleton), or for choosing a value (use Slider).

Motion: fill width animates with duration/base and easing/standard. Indeterminate slides over duration/pulse (2000ms) with easing/linear, looping. Under prefers-reduced-motion the slide stops.

Accessibility: role=progressbar with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow (omitted when indeterminate). Named by the label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; helper text is linked with aria-describedby; optional aria-valuetext. No hover, focus, active or disabled state.
